title: The Monday Brief
lede: Four decisions need you and one thing is stuck. Everything else moved on its own while you slept.
cadence: Next brief at 13:00. Until then you hear only about what cannot wait.

topics.name: Research
topics.progress: Answers asks from the other topics

decisions.title: Move €1,200 a week from LinkedIn to Google Search
decisions.context: A lead costs €200 on LinkedIn and €80 on Search. The weekly budget stays at €4,000.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The Paid agent starts now.

decisions.title: Start sequence B for 180 fintech ops leads
decisions.context: The pilot of 30 emails got 6 replies and 2 meetings. Sending stays at 60 a day.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The first 60 emails go out at 10:00.

decisions.title: Publish the Fenwick Freight customer story
decisions.context: Fenwick signed off the quote. The claim of 38% fewer manual hand-offs still needs your OK.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The story is scheduled for Wednesday.

decisions.title: Send the referral offer to Halden Freight Network
decisions.context: Halden wants a deal for its 2,400 business customers: 15% of first-year revenue for 12 months. Jonas drafted it from the template.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The offer goes out tomorrow at 09:00.

burns.title: The webinar promo visuals are stuck
burns.detail: Visuals used its 3 feedback rounds. 4 of 6 images pass the brand check, 2 still fail.

overnight.text: Research rebuilt the customer profile from 212 won deals and saved it to memory.
Partnerships added 32 brands from Clay, found 58 contacts in Apollo and drafted 24 emails for Lea to check.
SEO published the 2 comparison pages you approved on Friday.
Outbound stopped sequence A for the 14 people who replied.
Paid switched off 3 ads that fell below the click floor.

drafts.detail: The team update, the board note and 2 customer replies. Nothing is sent until you send it.
